people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Hor_Mount
people.line: Mountain where Aaron died and was buried

translations.web: Die on the mountain where you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor, and was gathered to his people;
translations.bsb: And there on the mountain that you climb, you will die and be gathered to your people, just as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people.
translations.kjv: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:
